scripts.title: Auto Play
scripts.author: tylenol
scripts.summary: Auto Player for Symphony Ochestra.
scripts.code:
if _G.__SYMPHONY_AP then
    local old = _G.__SYMPHONY_AP
    old.alive = false
    pcall(function() old.conn:Disconnect() end)
    pcall(function() old.win:Destroy() end)
    _G.__SYMPHONY_AP = nil
end

local Players = game:GetService('Players')
local RunService = game:GetService('RunService')
local LP = Players.LocalPlayer

local state = { alive = true, enabled = false, lastNote = {} }
_G.__SYMPHONY_AP = state

local function upsOf(f)
    local ok, ups = pcall(getupvalues, f)
    if not ok or type(ups) ~= 'table' then return nil end
    return ups
end

local engine, resolveErr = nil, nil
do
    local function isKeymap(t)
        for k in pairs(t) do
            return typeof(k) == 'EnumItem'
        end
        return false
    end

    local function validateLaneDown(f)
        if type(f) ~= 'function' then return nil end
        local ld = upsOf(f)
        if not ld or #ld < 13 then return nil end
        local Config = ld[8]
        if type(Config) ~= 'table' then return nil end
        if type(rawget(Config, 'PerfectWindow')) ~= 'number' then return nil end
        if type(rawget(Config, 'DefaultLaneKeys')) ~= 'table' then return nil end
        if type(ld[4]) ~= 'number' or type(ld[7]) ~= 'number' then return nil end
        if type(ld[10]) ~= 'table' or type(ld[2]) ~= 'table' then return nil end
        if type(ld[11]) ~= 'number' or type(ld[12]) ~= 'function' then return nil end
        return { laneDown = f, Config = Config, held = ld[2] }
    end

    local ok, res = pcall(function()
        local conns = getconnections(LP:GetAttributeChangedSignal('OrchestraPadKeys'))
        local found = nil
        for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
            if found then break end
            local u = upsOf(c.Function)
            if u and type(u[1]) == 'function' and type(u[2]) == 'boolean' and type(u[3]) == 'function' then
                local bl = upsOf(u[3])
                if bl then
                    for i = 1, #bl do
                        if found then break end
                        if type(bl[i]) == 'function' then
                            local ola = upsOf(bl[i])
                            if ola then
                                for j = 1, #ola do
                                    if found then break end
                                    if type(ola[j]) == 'function' then
                                        local hit = validateLaneDown(ola[j])
                                        if hit then
                                            local keymap
                                            for k = 1, #ola do
                                                if type(ola[k]) == 'table' and isKeymap(ola[k]) then
                                                    keymap = ola[k]
                                                end
                                            end
                                            if keymap then
                                                hit.onLaneAction = bl[i]
                                                hit.keymap = keymap
                                                found = hit
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        assert(found, 'RhythmClient lane engine not found')
        return found
    end)
    if ok then engine = res else resolveErr = tostring(res) end
end
state.engine = engine

local function pressLane(lane)
    local Config = engine.Config
    local keymap = engine.keymap
    local key = Config.LaneKeys and Config.LaneKeys[lane]
    if not (key and keymap[key] == lane) then
        key = nil
        for k, v in pairs(keymap) do
            if v == lane then key = k break end
        end
    end
    if not key then return false end
    return pcall(engine.onLaneAction, nil, Enum.UserInputState.Begin, { KeyCode = key })
end

if engine then
    state.conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not state.alive then return end
        if not state.enabled then return end

        local ld = upsOf(engine.laneDown)
        if not ld then return end
        local clockOff, songStart, notes = ld[4], ld[7], ld[10]
        if type(clockOff) ~= 'number' or type(songStart) ~= 'number' or type(notes) ~= 'table' then return end
        local n = #notes
        if n == 0 then return end

        local Config = engine.Config
        local audioOff = (Config.AudioOffset or 0) + (LP:GetAttribute('OrchestraAudioOffset') or 0) / 1000
        local pos = (os.clock() + clockOff) - songStart - audioOff

        local goodWindow = (type(ld[11]) == 'number' and ld[11]) or (Config.GoodWindow or 0.12)
        local horizon = goodWindow + (Config.LateGrace or 0.05) - 0.02

        for i = 1, n do
            local note = notes[i]
            if type(note) == 'table' and not note.Judged then
                local t = note.Time
                if type(t) == 'number' then
                    local dt = pos - t
                    if dt >= 0 and dt <= horizon then
                        local lane = note.Lane
                        if type(lane) == 'number' and lane >= 1 and lane <= 4 then
                            if pressLane(lane) then
                                state.lastNote[lane] = { t = t, len = tonumber(note.Length) or 0 }
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        for lane, info in pairs(state.lastNote) do
            if pos > info.t + info.len + 0.06 then
                engine.held[lane] = nil
                state.lastNote[lane] = nil
            end
        end
    end)
    print('[SymphonyAP] engine hooked: laneDown/onLaneAction/note-list online')
else
    warn('[SymphonyAP] engine hook FAILED: ' .. tostring(resolveErr))
end

local function setEnabled(v)
    state.enabled = v
    if not v then state.lastNote = {} end
end

local function fallbackGui()
    local gui = Instance.new('ScreenGui')
    gui.Name = 'SymphonyAutoplay'
    gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    gui.Parent = LP:WaitForChild('PlayerGui')
    local btn = Instance.new('TextButton')
    btn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 40)
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -75, 0, 8)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 48)
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    btn.TextSize = 16
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    btn.Text = 'Autoplay: OFF'
    btn.Parent = gui
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        setEnabled(not state.enabled)
        btn.Text = 'Autoplay: ' .. (state.enabled and 'ON' or 'OFF')
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = state.enabled and Color3.fromRGB(46, 160, 84) or Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 48)
    end)
    state.win = { Destroy = function() gui:Destroy() end }
    print('[SymphonyAP] WindUI unavailable, using fallback toggle')
end

local windOk = pcall(function()
    local WindUI = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Footagesus/WindUI/main/dist/main.lua'))()
    assert(typeof(WindUI) == 'table' and WindUI.CreateWindow, 'WindUI load failed')

    local Window = WindUI:CreateWindow({
        Title = 'Symphony Autoplay',
        Icon = 'music-note-bold-duotone',
        Folder = 'SymphonyAutoplay',
        OpenButton = { Enabled = true, Title = 'Symphony Autoplay' },
    })
    state.win = Window

    local Tab = Window:Tab({ Title = 'Autoplay', Icon = 'music-note-bold-duotone' })
    Tab:Toggle({
        Title = 'Autoplay Notes',
        Desc = 'Hits every note perfectly - holds included. Start any song and watch it play itself.',
        Default = false,
        Callback = function(v)
            setEnabled(v)
            WindUI:Notify({
                Title = 'Symphony Autoplay',
                Content = v and 'Enabled - start or keep playing a song.' or 'Disabled.',
                Icon = 'music-note-bold-duotone',
                Duration = 3,
            })
        end,
    })

    WindUI:Notify({
        Title = 'Symphony Autoplay',
        Content = engine and 'Engine hooked - ready to play.' or ('Hook failed: ' .. tostring(resolveErr)),
        Icon = 'music-note-bold-duotone',
        Duration = 5,
    })
    print('[SymphonyAP] WindUI ready')
end)

if not windOk then fallbackGui() end

scripts.title: [open source] Silent aim + Infinite Stamina + Tackle aim
scripts.author: chukunhax
scripts.summary: illegal soccer / Illegal Soccer : silent aim infinite stamina tackle aim perfect charge keyless open source chukunhax
scripts.code:
local rs, plrs, ws = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"), game:GetService("Players"), game:GetService("Workspace")
local lp = plrs.LocalPlayer

local chukunhax = {
	silent = true,
	hitchance = 80,
	corner = 78,
	spread = 1.4,
	perfectcharge = true,
	tackleaim = true,
	stamina = true,
}

local function mod(...)
	local n = rs
	for _, v in ipairs({ ... }) do n = n and n:FindFirstChild(v) end
	local ok, m = pcall(require, n)
	return ok and m or nil
end

local proto = mod("Modules", "Actions", "ActionRemoteProtocol")
local cmds = mod("Modules", "Actions", "ActionCommands")
local sprint = mod("Modules", "Actions", "Sprint")
local teams = mod("Client", "Gameplay", "ActorTeams")
local match = mod("Modules", "Gameplay", "MatchSettings")

local function getroot(c)
	return c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function goals()
	local d = ws:FindFirstChild("Map") and ws.Map:FindFirstChild("Data")
	local a, b = d and d:FindFirstChild("Team1"), d and d:FindFirstChild("Team2")
	return a and a:FindFirstChild("Goal"), b and b:FindFirstChild("Goal")
end

local function enemygoal()
	local a, b = goals()
	if not (a and b) then return a or b end
	local ok, mine = pcall(teams.GetCharacterTeamName, lp.Character)
	local ok2, opp = ok and pcall(match.GetOpposingTeamName, mine)
	if ok2 and opp == "Team1" then return a end
	if ok2 and opp == "Team2" then return b end
	local r = getroot(lp.Character)
	if not r then return a end
	return (a.Position - r.Position).Magnitude > (b.Position - r.Position).Magnitude and a or b
end

local function keeper(goal)
	local best, dist = nil, 1e9
	for _, p in ipairs(plrs:GetPlayers()) do
		local r = p ~= lp and p.Team ~= lp.Team and getroot(p.Character)
		if r then
			local d = (r.Position - goal.Position).Magnitude
			if d < dist then best, dist = r, d end
		end
	end
	return best
end

local function spot(goal)
	local side = math.random() > 0.5 and 1 or -1
	local k = keeper(goal)
	if k then side = goal.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(k.Position).X > 0 and -1 or 1 end
	local x = side * goal.Size.X / 2 * (chukunhax.corner / 100)
	local y = goal.Size.Y / 2 * 0.8
	local jx = (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * chukunhax.spread
	local jy = (math.random() - 0.5) * chukunhax.spread
	return (goal.CFrame * CFrame.new(x + jx, y + jy, 0)).Position
end

local function isshot(c)
	if c.Mode == "Volley" then return true end
	if cmds and typeof(cmds.IsVolley) == "function" then
		local ok, v = pcall(cmds.IsVolley, c)
		if ok and v then return true end
	end
	return c.PassType == "Shot"
end

local function closest()
	local me = getroot(lp.Character)
	local best, dist = nil, 25
	for _, p in ipairs(plrs:GetPlayers()) do
		local r = p ~= lp and p.Team ~= lp.Team and getroot(p.Character)
		if r and me then
			local d = (r.Position - me.Position).Magnitude
			if d < dist then best, dist = p, d end
		end
	end
	return best
end

local function aimat(c, pos)
	local aim = c.AimDirection
	local has = typeof(aim) == "table"
	local origin = has and aim.Origin
	if typeof(origin) ~= "Vector3" then
		local r = getroot(lp.Character)
		origin = r and r.Position
	end
	if not origin or (pos - origin).Magnitude < 0.1 then return end
	local dir = (pos - origin).Unit
	if has then
		aim.TargetPosition = pos
		aim.Direction = dir
	end
	c.TargetPosition = pos
	local flat = Vector3.new(dir.X, 0, dir.Z)
	if flat.Magnitude > 0 then c.KickDirection = flat.Unit end
end

local function edit(c)
	if chukunhax.perfectcharge and c.MaximumChargeSeconds then
		c.ChargeSeconds = c.MaximumChargeSeconds
	end
	if chukunhax.silent and isshot(c) and math.random(100) <= chukunhax.hitchance then
		local g = enemygoal()
		if g then aimat(c, spot(g)) end
	end
	if chukunhax.tackleaim and cmds and c.Kind == cmds.Kinds.Tackle and typeof(c.AimDirection) == "table" then
		local p = closest()
		local r = p and getroot(p.Character)
		if r then
			c.AimDirection.ClientHit = { Kind = "Player", UserId = p.UserId }
			c.TargetUserId = p.UserId
			aimat(c, r.Position)
		end
	end
end

for _, name in ipairs({ "Send", "Start", "Update", "Release" }) do
	local og = proto[name]
	if typeof(og) == "function" then
		proto[name] = function(c, ...)
			if typeof(c) == "table" then pcall(edit, c) end
			return og(c, ...)
		end
	end
end

if chukunhax.stamina and sprint and sprint.SetUnlimitedStamina then
	pcall(sprint.SetUnlimitedStamina, lp, "hax", true)
end

scripts.title: [open source] silent aim all guns / vehicles
scripts.author: chukunhax
scripts.summary: voxel wars fps silent aim
scripts.code:
local Players, RS = game:GetService("Players"), game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local lp, cam = Players.LocalPlayer, workspace.CurrentCamera

local CFG = { fov = 160, hitChance = 85, headChance = 55, wallcheck = true, players = true, bots = true }

local FIRE = {}
for _, n in ipairs({ "FireRifle", "FireSMG", "FireLMG", "FirePistol", "FireDMR", "FireSniper", "FireShotgun" }) do
	local r = RS.Voxel.Remotes:FindFirstChild(n)
	if r then FIRE[r] = n end
end
local Ballistics = require(RS.Voxel.Ballistics)

local params = RaycastParams.new()
params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

local function alive(model)
	local hum = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	return hum and hum.Health > 0 and model:GetAttribute("Alive") ~= false
end

local function pick()
	local center, best, bestDist = cam.ViewportSize / 2, nil, CFG.fov
	local myTeam = tostring(lp.Team)
	local function consider(model)
		local root = model:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not root or not alive(model) then return end
		local p, on = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position)
		if not on then return end
		local d = (Vector2.new(p.X, p.Y) - center).Magnitude
		if d >= bestDist then return end
		if CFG.wallcheck then
			params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { lp.Character, model }
			if workspace:Raycast(cam.CFrame.Position, root.Position - cam.CFrame.Position, params) then return end
		end
		best, bestDist = model, d
	end
	if CFG.players then
		for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if pl ~= lp and pl.Character and (pl.Team == nil or pl.Team ~= lp.Team) then consider(pl.Character) end
		end
	end
	local rigs = CFG.bots and workspace:FindFirstChild("BotRigs")
	if rigs then
		for _, m in ipairs(rigs:GetChildren()) do
			if m:GetAttribute("Team") ~= myTeam then consider(m) end
		end
	end
	return best
end

local function rewrite(name, a)
	local muzzle = a[1]
	if typeof(muzzle) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(a[2]) ~= "Vector3" then return end
	if math.random(100) > CFG.hitChance then return end
	local model = pick()
	if not model then return end
	local part = model:FindFirstChild(math.random(100) <= CFG.headChance and "Head" or "UpperTorso")
	if not part then return end

	local speed, arc = Ballistics.SPEED or 1700, nil
	if name == "FireSniper" then
		local tool = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
		speed = Ballistics.RIFLE_SPEED * ((tool and tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("GsVelocity"))) or 1)
		arc = Ballistics.RIFLE_ARC
	end

scripts.code:
getgenv().chukunhax = {
	autothrow = true,
	perfectthrow = true,
	fastthrow = true,
	fastspeed = 3,
}

local players = game:GetService("Players")
local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local env = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G

if type(env.chukunhax_stop) == "function" then pcall(env.chukunhax_stop) end

local chukunhax = env.chukunhax or {}
env.chukunhax = chukunhax
for key, value in pairs({ autothrow = false, perfectthrow = false, fastthrow = false, fastspeed = 3 }) do
	if chukunhax[key] == nil then chukunhax[key] = value end
end

local token = {}
env.chukunhax_token = token
local undo = {}
local function alive() return env.chukunhax_token == token end

env.chukunhax_stop = function()
	env.chukunhax_token = nil
	for i = #undo, 1, -1 do pcall(undo[i]) end
end

local lp = players.LocalPlayer
local function load(inst)
	local ok, module = pcall(require, inst)
	return ok and module or nil
end

local controllers = lp:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts"):WaitForChild("Client"):WaitForChild("Controllers")
local shared = rs:WaitForChild("Shared")
local state = load(controllers:WaitForChild("ClientState"))
local meter = load(controllers:WaitForChild("ThrowMeter"))
local game_config = load(rs:WaitForChild("Config"):WaitForChild("GameConfig"))
local meter_math = load(shared:WaitForChild("ThrowMeterMath"))
local arc = load(shared:WaitForChild("ProjectileMath"))
local anim = load(shared:WaitForChild("AnimationLibrary"))

local function speed()
	return chukunhax.fastspeed * (0.94 + math.random() * 0.12)
end

local function character()
	local char = lp.Character
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if root and hum and hum.Health > 0 then return char, root, hum end
end

local function loop(delay, fn)
	task.spawn(function()
		while alive() do
			pcall(fn)
			task.wait(delay)
		end
	end)
end

local orig_arc = arc and arc.CreateArc
if orig_arc then
	arc.CreateArc = function(a, b, time, ...)
		if chukunhax.fastthrow and type(time) == "number" then
			time = math.max(0.35, time / speed())
		end
		return orig_arc(a, b, time, ...)
	end
	undo[#undo + 1] = function() arc.CreateArc = orig_arc end
end

local orig_play = anim and anim.Play
if orig_play then
	anim.Play = function(rig, id, ...)
		local track = orig_play(rig, id, ...)
		if chukunhax.fastthrow and track and id == anim.GetThrowId() then
			pcall(track.AdjustSpeed, track, speed())
		end
		return track
	end
	undo[#undo + 1] = function() anim.Play = orig_play end
end

local sequence_keys = { "FadeIn", "FadeOut", "POVDuration", "RevealZoomNormal", "RevealZoomDramatic", "ShowTimeNormal", "ShowTimeShort", "SkipAfterRevealDelay" }
local sequence_original

local function sync_sequence()
	local sequence = game_config and game_config.Sequence
	if not sequence then return end
	if not sequence_original then
		sequence_original = {}
		for _, key in ipairs(sequence_keys) do sequence_original[key] = sequence[key] end
		undo[#undo + 1] = function()
			for key, value in pairs(sequence_original) do sequence[key] = value end
		end
	end
	for _, key in ipairs(sequence_keys) do
		if sequence_original[key] then
			sequence[key] = chukunhax.fastthrow and math.max(0.08, sequence_original[key] / chukunhax.fastspeed) or sequence_original[key]
		end
	end
end

local function sync_meter()
	if not (meter and meter_math) then return end
	if chukunhax.perfectthrow then
		meter.TestAutoTap = meter_math.HalfPeriod() - (0.005 + math.random() * 0.002)
	else
		meter.TestAutoTap = nil
	end
end
undo[#undo + 1] = function() if meter then meter.TestAutoTap = nil end end

local last_distance, last_progress = math.huge, os.clock()

local function walk_to(pos, tolerance)
	local _, root, hum = character()
	if not root or root.Anchored then return false end
	local flat = Vector3.new(root.Position.X - pos.X, 0, root.Position.Z - pos.Z).Magnitude
	if flat <= tolerance then
		last_distance, last_progress = math.huge, os.clock()
		return true
	end
	hum:MoveTo(pos)
	if flat < last_distance - 1 then
		last_distance, last_progress = flat, os.clock()
	elseif os.clock() - last_progress > 3 then
		root.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
		last_distance, last_progress = math.huge, os.clock()
	end
	return false
end

local function throw_target()
	local area = workspace:FindFirstChild("StarterArea")
	if not area then return end
	local line = area:FindFirstChild("CrossLine")
	local z = line and line.Position.Z or area.Position.Z + area.Size.Z / 2
	local _, root = character()
	local x = root and math.clamp(root.Position.X, area.Position.X - area.Size.X / 2 + 3, area.Position.X + area.Size.X / 2 - 3) or area.Position.X
	return Vector3.new(x, area.Position.Y + area.Size.Y / 2 + 3, z - 3)
end

loop(0.35, function()
	sync_meter()
	sync_sequence()
	local _, root = character()
	if not root or not chukunhax.autothrow then return end
	if state and (state.Busy or state.OfflineOpen) or root.Anchored then return end
	local target = throw_target()
	if target then walk_to(target, 1.5) end
end)

	["0"] = Enum.KeyCode.Zero, ["1"] = Enum.KeyCode.One, ["2"] = Enum.KeyCode.Two,
	["3"] = Enum.KeyCode.Three, ["4"] = Enum.KeyCode.Four, ["5"] = Enum.KeyCode.Five,
	["6"] = Enum.KeyCode.Six, ["7"] = Enum.KeyCode.Seven, ["8"] = Enum.KeyCode.Eight,
	["9"] = Enum.KeyCode.Nine, ["SPACE"] = Enum.KeyCode.Space, ["SPACEBAR"] = Enum.KeyCode.Space,
	[" "] = Enum.KeyCode.Space, ["LEFT"] = Enum.KeyCode.Left, ["ARROWLEFT"] = Enum.KeyCode.Left,
	["←"] = Enum.KeyCode.Left, ["RIGHT"] = Enum.KeyCode.Right, ["ARROWRIGHT"] = Enum.KeyCode.Right,
	["→"] = Enum.KeyCode.Right, ["UP"] = Enum.KeyCode.Up, ["ARROWUP"] = Enum.KeyCode.Up,
	["↑"] = Enum.KeyCode.Up, ["DOWN"] = Enum.KeyCode.Down, ["ARROWDOWN"] = Enum.KeyCode.Down,
	["↓"] = Enum.KeyCode.Down, [";"] = Enum.KeyCode.Semicolon, ["'"] = Enum.KeyCode.Quote,
	[","] = Enum.KeyCode.Comma, ["."] = Enum.KeyCode.Period, ["/"] = Enum.KeyCode.Slash,
	["\\"] = Enum.KeyCode.BackSlash, ["["] = Enum.KeyCode.LeftBracket, ["]"] = Enum.KeyCode.RightBracket,
	["-"] = Enum.KeyCode.Minus, ["="] = Enum.KeyCode.Equals, ["LSHIFT"] = Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift,
	["RSHIFT"] = Enum.KeyCode.RightShift, ["LCTRL"] = Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl, ["RCTRL"] = Enum.KeyCode.RightControl,
}

local enumList = Enum.KeyCode:GetEnumItems()

local function parseKey(txt)
	if type(txt) ~= "string" then return nil, "?" end
	local s = txt:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
	if s == "" then return nil, "?" end
	s = s:gsub("^Enum%.KeyCode%.", "")
	local br = s:match("^%[(.-)%]$")
	if br then s = br:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") end
	local up = s:upper()

	if keyMap[up] then return keyMap[up], s end

	local ok1, e1 = pcall(function() return Enum.KeyCode[s] end)
	if ok1 and typeof(e1) == "EnumItem" then return e1, s end

	local ok2, e2 = pcall(function() return Enum.KeyCode[up] end)
	if ok2 and typeof(e2) == "EnumItem" then return e2, up end

	for _, v in ipairs(enumList) do
		if v.Name:upper() == up then
			return v, v.Name
		end
	end
	return nil, s
end

local function grabKey(rec)
	local k = rec:FindFirstChild("Key")
	local raw
	if k then
		if k:IsA("TextLabel") or k:IsA("TextButton") or k:IsA("TextBox") then
			raw = k.Text
		elseif k:IsA("StringValue") then
			raw = k.Value
		elseif k:IsA("IntValue") or k:IsA("NumberValue") then
			raw = tostring(k.Value)
		end
	end
	if (not raw or raw == "") and rec:GetAttribute("Key") ~= nil then
		raw = tostring(rec:GetAttribute("Key"))
	end
	return parseKey(raw)
end

local hasFire = type(firesignal) == "function"
local hasConns = type(getconnections) == "function"

local function fireSig(sig, ...)
	if hasFire then
		pcall(firesignal, sig, ...)
	elseif hasConns then
		local ok, list = pcall(getconnections, sig)
		if ok and type(list) == "table" then
			for _, c in ipairs(list) do
				if c.Enabled ~= false then
					if type(c.Fire) == "function" then
						pcall(c.Fire, c, ...)
					elseif type(c.Function) == "function" then
						pcall(c.Function, ...)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local function gotConns(sig)
	if not hasConns then return false end
	local ok, list = pcall(getconnections, sig)
	return ok and type(list) == "table" and #list > 0
end

local function midOf(b)
	local p, sz = b.AbsolutePosition, b.AbsoluteSize
	return p.X + sz.X * 0.5, p.Y + sz.Y * 0.5
end

local function pressBtn(b)
	local x, y = midOf(b)
	if not hasFire and not hasConns then
		pcall(function() VIM:SendMouseButtonEvent(x, y, 0, true, game, 1) end)
		return
	end
	local sent = false
	if gotConns(b.MouseButton1Down) then
		fireSig(b.MouseButton1Down, x, y)
		sent = true
	end
	if gotConns(b.InputBegan) then
		fireSig(b.InputBegan, {
			UserInputType = Enum.UserInputType.Touch,
			UserInputState = Enum.UserInputState.Begin,
			Position = Vector3.new(x, y, 0),
			Delta = Vector3.zero,
			KeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.Unknown,
		}, false)
		sent = true
	end
	if not sent then
		if gotConns(b.Activated) then
			fireSig(b.Activated, {
				UserInputType = Enum.UserInputType.Touch,
				UserInputState = Enum.UserInputState.Begin,
				Position = Vector3.new(x, y, 0),
			}, 1)
			sent = true
		elseif gotConns(b.MouseButton1Click) then
			fireSig(b.MouseButton1Click)
			sent = true
		elseif gotConns(b.TouchTap) then
			fireSig(b.TouchTap, { Vector2.new(x, y) })
			sent = true
		end
	end
	if not sent and hasFire then
		fireSig(b.MouseButton1Down, x, y)
	end
end

local function releaseBtn(b)
	local x, y = midOf(b)
	if not hasFire and not hasConns then
		pcall(function() VIM:SendMouseButtonEvent(x, y, 0, false, game, 1) end)
		return
	end
	local sent = false
	if gotConns(b.MouseButton1Up) then
		fireSig(b.MouseButton1Up, x, y)
		sent = true
	end
	if gotConns(b.InputEnded) then
		fireSig(b.InputEnded, {
			UserInputType = Enum.UserInputType.Touch,
			UserInputState = Enum.UserInputState.End,
			Position = Vector3.new(x, y, 0),
			Delta = Vector3.zero,
			KeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.Unknown,
		}, false)
		sent = true
	end
	if not sent and not hasConns and hasFire then
		fireSig(b.MouseButton1Up, x, y)
	end
end

local function rel(idx)
	local d = down[idx]
	if not d then return end
	down[idx] = nil
	if d.m == "Key" and d.k then
		pcall(function() VIM:SendKeyEvent(false, d.k, false, game) end)
	elseif d.m == "Touch" and d.b and d.b.Parent then
		releaseBtn(d.b)
	end
end

local function press(info)
	local idx = info.idx
	if down[idx] then rel(idx) end
	if mode == "Touch" then
		if not info.btn then return false end
		down[idx] = { m = "Touch", b = info.btn }
		pressBtn(info.btn)
		return true
	else
		if not info.key then return false end
		down[idx] = { m = "Key", k = info.key }
		pcall(function() VIM:SendKeyEvent(true, info.key, false, game) end)
		return true
	end
end

local function checkHit(obj, rec)
	local gp, gs = obj.AbsolutePosition, obj.AbsoluteSize
	local rp, rs = rec.AbsolutePosition, rec.AbsoluteSize
	if gs.X <= 1 or gs.Y <= 1 or rs.X <= 1 or rs.Y <= 1 then return false, false end

	local cx = gp.X + gs.X * 0.5
	if cx < rp.X or cx > (rp.X + rs.X) then return false, false end

	local hit = (gp.Y + gs.Y >= rp.Y - off) and (gp.Y <= rp.Y + rs.Y)
	return hit, gs.Y > (rs.Y * 1.6)
end

local function findTail(note, rec, tails)
	local np, ns = note.AbsolutePosition, note.AbsoluteSize
	local nt, nb = np.Y, np.Y + ns.Y
	local rp, rs = rec.AbsolutePosition, rec.AbsoluteSize
	local rl, rr = rp.X, rp.X + rs.X

	local best, bestD = nil, math.huge
	for _, tl in ipairs(tails) do
		if tl.Visible then
			local tp, ts = tl.AbsolutePosition, tl.AbsoluteSize
			if ts.X > 1 and ts.Y > 1 then
				local tx = tp.X + ts.X * 0.5
				if tx >= rl and tx <= rr then
					local tt, tb = tp.Y, tp.Y + ts.Y
					if tb >= (nt - 40) and tt <= (nb + 40) then
						local d = math.abs(tb - nt)
						if d < bestD then
							bestD = d
							best = tl
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

local function getBtn(lane, rec)

	return lane:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("GuiButton") or rec:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("GuiButton")
end

local function scanLanes(hw)
	local out = {}
	for _, ch in ipairs(hw:GetChildren()) do
		local n = ch.Name:match("^Lane(%d+)$")
		if n and ch:IsA("GuiObject") and ch.Visible then
			local rec = ch:FindFirstChild("Receptor")
			if rec and rec:IsA("GuiObject") and rec.Visible then
				local kc, kl = grabKey(rec)
				out[#out + 1] = {
					idx = tonumber(n),
					lane = ch,
					rec = rec,
					btn = getBtn(ch, rec),
					key = kc,
					lbl = kl,
				}
			end
		end
	end
	table.sort(out, function(a, b) return a.idx < b.idx end)
	return out
end

local loop = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	fc += 1

	for idx, chp in pairs(chips) do
		chp.BackgroundColor3 = if down[idx] then uikit.Colors.Gold else uikit.Colors.Raised
	end

	local og = pg:FindFirstChild("OrchestraGui")
	local hw = og and og:FindFirstChild("Highway")

	if not og or not og.Enabled or not hw or not hw.Visible then
		if on then
			clearAll()
			stLbl.Text = "Status: Waiting for song..."
		end
		return
	end

	local lanes = scanLanes(hw)
	if #lanes == 0 then
		if on then
			clearAll()
			stLbl.Text = "Status: No receptors found"
		end
		return
	end

	syncChips(lanes)
	if not on then return end

	local byIdx = {}
	for _, v in ipairs(lanes) do byIdx[v.idx] = v end

	for idx in pairs(down) do
		if not byIdx[idx] then
			rel(idx)
			tailsHeld[idx] = nil
			notesHeld[idx] = nil
			relAt[idx] = nil
		end
	end

	stLbl.Text = string.format("Running [%s] (%dL)", mode, #lanes)

	for _, v in ipairs(lanes) do
		local i = v.idx
		local ht = tailsHeld[i]
		if ht then
			local t = ht.t
			if not t.Parent or not t.Visible or t.AbsoluteSize.X <= 1 or t.AbsoluteSize.Y <= 1 then
				tailsHeld[i] = nil
				rel(i)
			else
				if checkHit(t, v.rec) then
					ht.inRec = true
				elseif ht.inRec or (fc - ht.sf) > 35 then
					tailsHeld[i] = nil
					rel(i)
				end
			end
		elseif notesHeld[i] then
			local hn = notesHeld[i]
			if not hn.Parent or not hn.Visible then
				notesHeld[i] = nil
				rel(i)
			end
		elseif relAt[i] and fc >= relAt[i] then
			relAt[i] = nil
			rel(i)
		end
	end

	local notes, tails = {}, {}
	for _, ch in ipairs(hw:GetChildren()) do
		if ch:IsA("GuiObject") then
			if ch.Name == "Note" then
				notes[#notes + 1] = ch
			elseif ch.Name == "Tail" then
				tails[#tails + 1] = ch
			end
		end
	end

	for _, n in ipairs(notes) do
		if not n.Visible then
			seen[n] = nil
		else
			local any = false
			for _, v in ipairs(lanes) do
				local hit, tall = checkHit(n, v.rec)
				if hit then
					any = true
					if not seen[n] then
						seen[n] = true
						if press(v) then
							hits += 1
							if hitTxt then hitTxt.Text = hits .. " hits" end
							local i = v.idx
							local tl = findTail(n, v.rec, tails)
							if tl then
								tailsHeld[i] = { t = tl, inRec = checkHit(tl, v.rec), sf = fc }
								notesHeld[i] = nil
								relAt[i] = nil
							elseif tall then
								notesHeld[i] = n
								relAt[i] = nil
							else
								relAt[i] = fc + 1
							end
						end
					end
					break
				end
			end
			if not any then
				seen[n] = nil
				for _, v in ipairs(lanes) do
					if notesHeld[v.idx] == n then
						notesHeld[v.idx] = nil
						rel(v.idx)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

	on = false

	clearAll()

local function CallGeminiAPI(userMessage)
    local body = HttpService:JSONEncode({
        contents = {{ parts = {{ text = userMessage }} }}
    })
    
    local success, response = pcall(function()
        return request({
            Url = "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-2.0-flash-exp:generateContent?key=" .. Api_Gemini67,
            Method = "POST",
            Headers = {
                ["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
            },
            Body = body
        })
    end)
    
    if not success then
        return "Error: Request failed - " .. tostring(response)
    end
    
    if not response or not response.Body then
        return "Error: No response from server"
    end
    
    local decodeSuccess, data = pcall(function()
        return HttpService:JSONDecode(response.Body)
    end)
    
    if not decodeSuccess then
        return "Error: Invalid response format - " .. tostring(data)
    end
    
    if data and data.candidates and data.candidates[1] and 
       data.candidates[1].content and data.candidates[1].content.parts and
       data.candidates[1].content.parts[1] and data.candidates[1].content.parts[1].text then
        local aiText = data.candidates[1].content.parts[1].text
        return aiText
    end
    
    if data and data.error then
        return "API Error: " .. (data.error.message or "Unknown error")
    end
    
    return "Error: Unable to parse AI response. Check console for details."
end

local function AddMessage(sender, message, isUser)
    local messageLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    messageLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 0)
    messageLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    messageLabel.TextColor3 = isUser and Color3.fromRGB(100, 200, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    messageLabel.FontFace = Font.new([[rbxasset://fonts/families/Inconsolata.json]], Enum.FontWeight.Regular, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
    messageLabel.TextSize = 14
    messageLabel.TextWrapped = true
    messageLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    messageLabel.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
    messageLabel.Text = sender .. ": " .. message
    messageLabel.Parent = G2L["ScrollingFrame_c"]
    
    local textBounds = game:GetService("TextService"):GetTextSize(
        messageLabel.Text,
        messageLabel.TextSize,
        Enum.Font.Code,
        Vector2.new(messageLabel.AbsoluteSize.X, math.huge)
    )
    messageLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, math.max(textBounds.Y + 10, 30))
    
    UpdateScrollingFrame()
    return messageLabel
end

local function ExtractCodeBlocks(message)
    local parts = {}
    local lastIndex = 1
    
    for codeStart, language, code, codeEnd in message:gmatch("()```([%w]*)\n?(.-)\n?```()") do
        if codeStart > lastIndex then
            local textBefore = message:sub(lastIndex, codeStart - 1)
            if textBefore:gsub("%s+", "") ~= "" then
                table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = textBefore})
            end
        end
        
        table.insert(parts, {type = "code", content = code, language = language})
        lastIndex = codeEnd
    end
    
    if lastIndex <= #message then
        local textAfter = message:sub(lastIndex)
        if textAfter:gsub("%s+", "") ~= "" then
            table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = textAfter})
        end
    end
    
    if #parts == 0 then
        table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = message})
    end
    
    return parts
end


local function DisplayAIResponse(message)
    local parts = ExtractCodeBlocks(message)
    local senderAdded = false
    
    for i, part in ipairs(parts) do
        if part.type == "text" then
            if not senderAdded then
                AddMessage(currentAI, part.content, false)
                senderAdded = true
            else
                AddMessage("", part.content, false)
            end
        elseif part.type == "code" then
            CreateCodeBlock(part.content, part.language)
        end
    end
end

    loadingLabel.Parent = G2L["ScrollingFrame_c"]
    
    UpdateScrollingFrame()
    
    local dots = 0
    local animationRunning = true
    
    task.spawn(function()
        while animationRunning and loadingLabel.Parent do

        end
    end)
    
    return loadingLabel, function()
        animationRunning = false
    end
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
local RootPart = Character.HumanoidRootPart

local stages = workspace.stages
local currentstage = LocalPlayer.leaderstats.Stage

local function FindNextPortal()
	for i,v in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
		if v.Name == "Stage Teleport" and #v:GetChildren() == 4 then
			local enter = v:FindFirstChild("enter")
			if enter ~= nil then
				return enter
			end
		end
	end
end

local function Touch(Part)
	firetouchinterest(RootPart, Part, 0)
	firetouchinterest(RootPart, Part, 1)
end
while task.wait() do
	local CurrentStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value))
	local NextStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value + 1))
	local NextNextStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value + 1))
	RootPart.CFrame = CurrentStage.CFrame * CFrame.new(0,3,0)
	if NextStage then
		Touch(NextStage)
		--Potential Speed Gain?
		if NextNextStage then
			Touch(NextNextStage)
		end
	else
		local NextPortal = FindNextPortal()
		if NextPortal then
			RootPart.CFrame = NextPortal.CFrame
		else
			RootPart.CFrame = CurrentStage.CFrame
		end
		task.wait(1)
	end
end
for i,v in pairs(workspace.badges:GetChildren()) do
	if v.Name == "Platform" then
		Touch(v)
	end
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

screenGui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

local currentKey = nil

local function setupCharacter(character)
    local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
    animation.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://72722244508749"
    local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or Instance.new("Animator", humanoid)
    local animTrack = animator:LoadAnimation(animation)

    screenGui:ClearAllChildren()

    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 100)
    frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -100, 0.5, -50)
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
    frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    frame.Parent = screenGui
    frame.Active = true
    frame.Draggable = true

    local playBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    playBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 40)
    playBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
    playBtn.Text = "Play Animation"
    playBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 130, 180)
    playBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    playBtn.Parent = frame

    playBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        animTrack:Play()
    end)

    local keybindBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    keybindBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 40)
    keybindBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 50)
    keybindBtn.Text = currentKey and ("Set Keybind (Current: " .. tostring(currentKey) .. ")") or "Set Keybind (Current: none)"
    keybindBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 50, 150)
    keybindBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    keybindBtn.TextScaled = true
    keybindBtn.Parent = frame

    local waitingForKey = false

    keybindBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        keybindBtn.Text = "Press a key..."
        waitingForKey = true
    end)

    UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
        if waitingForKey and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
            currentKey = input.KeyCode
            keybindBtn.Text = "Set Keybind (Current: " .. tostring(currentKey) .. ")"
            waitingForKey = false
        elseif currentKey and input.KeyCode == currentKey and not gameProcessed then
            animTrack:Play()
        end
    end)
end

if player.Character then
    setupCharacter(player.Character)
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
    setupCharacter(char)
end)

local function notify(text, duration)
	local notif = Instance.new("Frame")
	notif.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	notif.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 34, 36)
	notif.BorderSizePixel = 0
	notif.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	notif.ClipsDescendants = true
	notif.Parent = notifications
	
	local nCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	nCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 3)
	nCorner.Parent = notif
	
	local nStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	nStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(85, 90, 95)
	nStroke.Thickness = 1
	nStroke.Transparency = 1
	nStroke.Parent = notif
	
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, 0)
	label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 0)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = text
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 205, 210)
	label.TextSize = 11
	label.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.TextWrapped = true
	label.TextTransparency = 1
	label.Parent = notif
	
	local textBounds = label.TextBounds.Y + 12
	
	TweenService:Create(notif, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, textBounds),
		BackgroundTransparency = 0
	}):Play()
	
	TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {TextTransparency = 0}):Play()
	TweenService:Create(nStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {Transparency = 0}):Play()
	
	task.delay(duration or 3, function()
		TweenService:Create(notif, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1
		}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(nStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {Transparency = 1}):Play()
		task.wait(0.25)
		notif:Destroy()
	end)
end

local visible = false
local animating = false

local function toggleGui()
	if animating then return end
	animating = true
	visible = not visible
	
	local targetPos = visible and UDim2.new(1, -290, 0.5, -190) or UDim2.new(1, 300, 0.5, -190)
	
	TweenService:Create(main, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Position = targetPos
	}):Play()
	
	task.wait(0.35)
	animating = false
end

hideBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleGui)

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
	if gpe then return end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.P then
		toggleGui()
	end
end)

local processed = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local originalSounds = {}

local function optimizeGame()
	local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
	Lighting.Technology = Enum.Technology.Compatibility
	Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
	Lighting.ShadowSoftness = 0
	
	local function process(obj)
		if processed[obj] then return end
		processed[obj] = true
		
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			obj.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			obj.CastShadow = false
		elseif obj:IsA("Sound") then
			originalSounds[obj] = obj.SoundId
			if getgenv().StretchConfig.CustomSoundsEnabled then
				obj.SoundId = getgenv().StretchConfig.PopSoundId
			end
		elseif obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			obj.Texture = getgenv().StretchConfig.DotTexture
			obj.Rate = 5
			obj.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.1)
		end
	end
	
	for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		task.spawn(process, obj)
	end
	
	workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(process)
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if not getgenv().StretchConfig.CustomSoundsEnabled then return end
	
	for sound, original in pairs(originalSounds) do
		if sound and sound.Parent then
			sound.SoundId = getgenv().StretchConfig.PopSoundId
		end
	end
end)

local function applyForceField(plr, character)
	if plr.Name ~= getgenv().StretchConfig.ForceFieldUser then return end
	for _, obj in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			obj.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
			obj.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("White")
			obj.CastShadow = false
		end
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(plr)
	plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
		task.spawn(applyForceField, plr, char)
	end)
end)

if player.Character then
	task.spawn(applyForceField, player, player.Character)
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
	task.spawn(applyForceField, player, char)
end)

local holding = false

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
	if gpe or not getgenv().StretchConfig.AutoSprint then return end
	if input.KeyCode == getgenv().StretchConfig.SprintKey then
		VM:SendKeyEvent(true, getgenv().StretchConfig.HoldKey, false, game)
		holding = true
	end
end)

UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.KeyCode == getgenv().StretchConfig.SprintKey and holding then
		VM:SendKeyEvent(false, getgenv().StretchConfig.HoldKey, false, game)
		holding = false
	end
end)

local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if not getgenv().StretchConfig.StretchEnabled then return end
	
	local cfg = getgenv().StretchConfig
	Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame * CFrame.new(
		0, 0, 0,
		1, 0, 0,
		0, cfg.Scale, 0,
		0, 0, 1
	)
end)

task.spawn(optimizeGame)
notify("Screen Stretch • Press P", 3)

local function fireproximityprompt(Obj, Amount, Skip)
    if Obj.ClassName == "ProximityPrompt" then 
        Amount = Amount or 1
        local PromptTime = Obj.HoldDuration
        if Skip then 
            Obj.HoldDuration = 0
        end
        for i = 1, Amount do 
            Obj:InputHoldBegin()
            if not Skip then 
                wait(Obj.HoldDuration)
            end
            Obj:InputHoldEnd()
        end
        Obj.HoldDuration = PromptTime
    else 
        error("userdata<ProximityPrompt> expected")
    end
end

local fov = 36
local maxDistance = 350
local maxTransparency = 0.1
local teamCheck = false
local wallCheck = true
local aimPart = "Head"  -- "Torso"

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Cam = game.Workspace.CurrentCamera

local FOVring = Drawing.new("Circle")
FOVring.Visible = true
FOVring.Thickness = 2
FOVring.Color = Color3.fromRGB(128, 0, 128)
FOVring.Filled = false
FOVring.Radius = fov
FOVring.Position = Cam.ViewportSize / 2

local function updateDrawings()
    FOVring.Position = Cam.ViewportSize / 2
end

local function lookAt(target)
    local lookVector = (target - Cam.CFrame.Position).unit
    local newCFrame = CFrame.new(Cam.CFrame.Position, Cam.CFrame.Position + lookVector)
    Cam.CFrame = newCFrame
end

local function calculateTransparency(distance)
    return (1 - (distance / fov)) * maxTransparency
end

local function isPlayerAlive(player)
    local character = player.Character
    return character and character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and character.Humanoid.Health > 0
end

local function isPlayerVisibleThroughWalls(player, trg_part)
    if not wallCheck then
        return true
    end

    local localPlayerCharacter = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
    if not localPlayerCharacter then
        return false
    end

    local part = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild(trg_part)
    if not part then
        return false
    end

    local ray = Ray.new(Cam.CFrame.Position, part.Position - Cam.CFrame.Position)
    local hit, _ = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(ray, {localPlayerCharacter})

    if hit and hit:IsDescendantOf(player.Character) then
        return true
    end

    -- Fallback to a nearby position if the direct ray doesn't hit
    local direction = (part.Position - Cam.CFrame.Position).unit
    local nearRay = Ray.new(Cam.CFrame.Position + direction * 2, direction * maxDistance)
    local nearHit, _ = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(nearRay, {localPlayerCharacter})

    return nearHit and nearHit:IsDescendantOf(player.Character)
end

local function getClosestPlayerInFOV()
    local nearest = nil
    local last = math.huge
    local playerMousePos = Cam.ViewportSize / 2
    local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= localPlayer and (not teamCheck or player.Team ~= localPlayer.Team) and isPlayerAlive(player) then
            local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
            local part = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild(aimPart)
            if humanoid and part then
                local ePos, isVisible = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
                local distance = (Vector2.new(ePos.x, ePos.y) - playerMousePos).Magnitude

                if distance < last and isVisible and distance < fov and distance < maxDistance and isPlayerVisibleThroughWalls(player, aimPart) then
                    last = distance
                    nearest = player
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return nearest
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    updateDrawings()
    local closest = getClosestPlayerInFOV()
    if closest and closest.Character:FindFirstChild(aimPart) then
        lookAt(closest.Character[aimPart].Position)
    end
    
    if closest then
        local part = closest.Character[aimPart]
        local ePos, isVisible = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
        local distance = (Vector2.new(ePos.x, ePos.y) - (Cam.ViewportSize / 2)).Magnitude
        FOVring.Transparency = calculateTransparency(distance)
    else
        FOVring.Transparency = maxTransparency
    end
end)
        end

local function formatNumber(n)
    local formatted = tostring(n)
    local k
    while true do
        formatted, k = string.gsub(formatted, "^(-?%d+)(%d%d%d)", '%1,%2')
        if k == 0 then break end
    end
    return formatted
end

local function checkCashRegister()
    if bag.Value >= bagSizeLevel.Value then
        moveToTarget()
        return false

    for i = 1, #cashRegisters do
        local item = cashRegisters[i]
        local openPart = item:FindFirstChild("Open")
        if openPart then
            humanoidRootPart.CFrame = openPart.CFrame
            robEvent:FireServer("Register", {
                Part = item:FindFirstChild("Union"),
                OpenPart = openPart,
                ActiveValue = item:FindFirstChild("Active"),
                Active = true
            })
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function checkSafe()
    if bag.Value >= bagSizeLevel.Value then
        moveToTarget()
        return false
    end
    for i = 1, #safes do
        local item = safes[i]
        if item:FindFirstChild("Amount") and item.Amount.Value > 0 then
            local safePart = item:FindFirstChild("Safe")
            if safePart then
                humanoidRootPart.CFrame = safePart.CFrame
                local openFlag = item:FindFirstChild("Open")
                if openFlag and openFlag.Value then

                else

                    if openSafe then
                        openSafe:FireServer("Completed")
                    end
                    robEvent:FireServer("Safe", item)
                end
                return true
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function Descendants(tbl)
    local descendants = {}
    
    local function process_table(subtbl, prefix)
        for k, v in pairs(subtbl) do
            local index = prefix and (prefix .. "." .. tostring(k)) or tostring(k)
            descendants[index] = v
            if type(v) == 'table' then
                process_table(v, index)
            else
                descendants[index] = v
            end
        end
    end

    if type(tbl) ~= 'table' then
        descendants[tostring(1)] = tbl
    else
        process_table(tbl, nil)
    end
    
    return descendants
end

        code = code:gsub(p.pattern, function(var1, var2, tbl)

local function toluau(code)
    for _, p in ipairs(patterns) do
        code = code:gsub(p.pattern, function(var, value)

    end

funcs.base64.encode = function(data)
    local letters = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
    return ((data:gsub('.', function(x) 
        local r,b='',x:byte()
        for i=8,1,-1 do r=r..(b%2^i-b%2^(i-1)>0 and '1' or '0') end
        return r;
    end)..'0000'):gsub('%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?', function(x)
        if (#x < 6) then return '' end
        local c=0
        for i=1,6 do c=c+(x:sub(i,i)=='1' and 2^(6-i) or 0) end
        return letters:sub(c+1,c+1)
    end)..({ '', '==', '=' })[#data%3+1])
end
funcs.base64.decode = function(data)
    local b = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
    data = string.gsub(data, '[^'..b..'=]', '')
    return (data:gsub('.', function(x)
        if x == '=' then return '' end
        local r, f = '', (b:find(x) - 1)
        for i = 6, 1, -1 do
            r = r .. (f % 2^i - f % 2^(i - 1) > 0 and '1' or '0')
        end
        return r;
    end):gsub('%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?', function(x)
        if #x ~= 8 then return '' end
        local c = 0
        for i = 1, 8 do
            c = c + (x:sub(i, i) == '1' and 2^(8 - i) or 0)
        end
        return string.char(c)
    end))
end

 local result = {}
 a = tostring(a) b = tostring(b)
 for i = 1, #a do
    local byte = string.byte(a, i)
    local keyByte = string.byte(b, (i - 1) % #b + 1)
    table.insert(result, string.char(bit32.bxor(byte, keyByte)))
 end

     end
     return Files
    end

        local a = Instance.new("Frame", Instance.new("ScreenGui", DrawingDict))
        a.Visible = false
        a.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
        a.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        a.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        a.BorderSizePixel = 0

        local meta = baseProps
        meta.ClassName = Type
        meta.__index = {
            Thickness = 1,
            From = Vector2.new(0, 0),
            To = Vector2.new(0, 0),
            Transparency = 0,
            Remove = function()
               for i, v in pairs(Drawings) do if v == meta then Drawings[i] = nil end end
               a:Destroy() 
            end,
            Destroy = function()
               for i, v in pairs(Drawings) do if v == meta then Drawings[i] = nil end end
               a:Destroy() 
            end,
            updateLine = function(self)
             if not a then return end
             local from = self.From
             local to = self.To
             local distance = (to - from).Magnitude
             local angle = math.deg(math.atan2(to.Y - from.Y, to.X - from.X))

             a.Size = UDim2.new(0, distance, 0, self.Thickness)
             a.Position = UDim2.new(0, from.X, 0, from.Y)
             a.Rotation = angle
            end
        }

        meta.__newindex = function(self, key, value)
            if not self then return end
            if key == 'Thickness' and typeof(value) == 'number' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.Size = UDim2.new(0, (self.To - self.From).Magnitude, 0, value)
            elseif key == 'Visible' and typeof(value) == 'boolean' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.Visible = value
            elseif key == 'Color' and typeof(value) == 'Color3' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.BackgroundColor3 = value
            elseif key == 'Transparency' and typeof(value) == 'number' and value <= 1 then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - value
            elseif key == 'From' and typeof(value) == 'Vector2' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                self:updateLine()
            elseif key == 'To' and typeof(value) == 'Vector2' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                self:updateLine()
            end
        end

        Drawings[meta1] = meta1
        return meta1

               for i, v in pairs(Drawings) do if v == meta then Drawings[i] = nil end end
               a:Destroy()

             if not b or not a then return end
             a.Size = UDim2.new(0, self.Radius, 0, self.Radius)

             b.Enabled = not self

function processTableDescendants(tbl, indent, tblname)
    indent = indent or 0

function DecompileFunction(func, excludename, indent, customname)

        if inf.numparams > 0 then

        elseif typeof(v):lower() == "number" then
            if os.time() - v < 1 then

     end
    end
    if #getupvalues(func) == 0 then

    local consts = string.rep("  ", indent) .. "--[[ Detected roblox functions list"

                            Decompiled = Decompiled .. ("\nlocal table_%d = {}; --[[ EMPTY TABLE ]]\n"):format(pKey1(i, v))

                        end
                    else
                        if type(i) == "number" then

                                Decompiled ..
                                ("local table_%d = {\n%s};"):format(
                                    pKey1(i, v),
                                    processTableDescendants(v, 0, "t_" .. tostring(i))
                                )
                        else
                            Decompiled =
                                Decompiled ..
                                ("local %s = {\n%s};\n"):format(i, processTableDescendants(v, 0, "t_" .. tostring(i)))
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            for i, v in gcsenv(Script) do -- garbage collection senv
                local name = debug.getinfo(v).name
                if name == nil and Settings.IncludeNils then
                    Decompiled = Decompiled .. ("\n%s"):format(DecompileFunction(v, false, 0, "nil" .. tostring(uks)))
                    uks = uks + 1
                elseif name ~= nil then
                    Decompiled = Decompiled .. ("\n%s"):format(DecompileFunction(v, false, 0))
                end
            end
        end
    )
    if not s then
        return " --An error occured while attempting to iterate over Script's enviroment!\nMessage: " .. e
    end
    return Decompiled
end

local Targets = { list = {}, hums = {}, isBot = {} }
local BOT_KEYWORDS = {
    "piggy","bot","npc","zizzy","pony","mimi","bunny","doggy",
    "mr.p","mr p","mrp","sheepy","george","memory","antagonist"
}

local function looksLikeBot(char)
    local n = char.Name:lower()
    for _, kw in ipairs(BOT_KEYWORDS) do
        if n:find(kw, 1, true) then return true end
    end
    return not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(char)
end

local function refreshTargets()
    table.clear(Targets.list)
    table.clear(Targets.hums)
    table.clear(Targets.isBot)
    
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character then
            local char = plr.Character
            local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local hum  = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if root and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                Targets.list[root]  = char
                Targets.hums[root]  = hum
                Targets.isBot[root] = false
            end
        end
    end

    for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("Model") and obj ~= LocalPlayer.Character then
            local hum  = obj:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local root = obj:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hum and root and hum.Health > 0 and looksLikeBot(obj) then
                Targets.list[root]  = obj
                Targets.hums[root]  = hum
                Targets.isBot[root] = true
            end
        end
    end
end

local function acquireEntry()
    local t = table.remove(ESP.pool)
    if t then return t end
    
    local box = Instance.new("Frame")
    box.BackgroundTransparency = 1; box.BorderSizePixel = 0; box.Visible = false; box.Parent = espGui
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke"); stroke.Thickness = 1; stroke.Parent = box
    
    local nameLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    nameLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1; nameLbl.Font = Enum.Font.RobotoMono; nameLbl.TextSize = 12
    nameLbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0; nameLbl.TextStrokeColor3 = C.Black
    nameLbl.Size = UDim2.new(0, 240, 0, 14); nameLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    nameLbl.Visible = false; nameLbl.Parent = espGui
    
    local distLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    distLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1; distLbl.Font = Enum.Font.RobotoMono; distLbl.TextSize = 10
    distLbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0; distLbl.TextStrokeColor3 = C.Black
    distLbl.Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 12); distLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    distLbl.Visible = false; distLbl.Parent = espGui
    
    local hpBg = Instance.new("Frame")
    hpBg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40,40,40); hpBg.BorderSizePixel = 0; hpBg.Visible = false; hpBg.Parent = espGui
    
    local hpBar = Instance.new("Frame")
    hpBar.BackgroundColor3 = C.HealthHigh; hpBar.BorderSizePixel = 0; hpBar.Visible = false; hpBar.Parent = espGui
    
    return { Box = box, Stroke = stroke, Name = nameLbl, Dist = distLbl, HpBg = hpBg, HpBar = hpBar }
end

local function releaseEntry(e)
    if not e then return end
    e.Box.Visible = false; e.Name.Visible = false; e.Dist.Visible = false
    e.HpBg.Visible = false; e.HpBar.Visible = false
    if #ESP.pool < ESP.maxPool then table.insert(ESP.pool, e) else
        e.Box:Destroy(); e.Name:Destroy(); e.Dist:Destroy(); e.HpBg:Destroy(); e.HpBar:Destroy()
    end
end

local ITEM_PATTERNS = {"key","lockpick","hammer","screwdriver","wrench","gas","cank","canister","battery","fuse","gun","weapon","knife","bat","crowbar","flashlight","coin","ticket","trophy","cure","antidote"}
local EXIT_PATTERNS = {"exit","escape","door","goal","objective","checkpoint","elevator","gate"}

local function matchesAny(name, patterns)
    if not name then return false end
    local l = name:lower()
    for _, p in ipairs(patterns) do if l:find(p, 1, true) then return true end end
    return false
end

local WorldObjects = {}
local function refreshWorldObjects()
    table.clear(WorldObjects)
    local hrp = getHRP()
    if not hrp then return end
    
    for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj.Name ~= "" then
            local isItem = State.ItemESP and matchesAny(obj.Name, ITEM_PATTERNS)
            local isExit = State.ExitESP and matchesAny(obj.Name, EXIT_PATTERNS)
            if isItem or isExit then
                local d = (obj.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
                if d <= State.ESP_MaxDist then
                    table.insert(WorldObjects, { part = obj, dist = d, cat = isExit and "EXIT" or "ITEM" })
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not (State.ItemESP or State.PiggyESP or State.PlayerESP or State.ExitESP) then
        for _, e in pairs(ESP.active) do releaseEntry(e) end
        table.clear(ESP.active)
        return
    end
    
    local hrp = getHRP()
    if not hrp then return end
    
    local vp = camera.ViewportSize
    local nowUsed = {}
    
    for root, char in pairs(Targets.list) do
        if char and char.Parent and root and root.Parent then
            local hum = Targets.hums[root]
            if hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                local isBot = Targets.isBot[root]
                local wanted = (isBot and State.PiggyESP) or (not isBot and State.PlayerESP)
                if wanted then
                    local dist = (root.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
                    if dist <= State.ESP_MaxDist then
                        local e = ESP.active[root]
                        if not e then e = acquireEntry(); ESP.active[root] = e end
                        nowUsed[root] = true
                        
                        local pos, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position)
                        if onScreen and pos.Z > 0 and pos.X > -100 and pos.X < vp.X + 100 and pos.Y > -100 and pos.Y < vp.Y + 100 then
                            local scale = 1000 / math.max(dist, 1)
                            local boxW = math.clamp(3 * scale, 12, 220)
                            local boxH = boxW * 1.5
                            local col = isBot and C.Bot or C.Player
                            
                            if State.ESP_Boxes then
                                e.Box.Size = UDim2.new(0, boxW, 0, boxH)
                                e.Box.Position = UDim2.new(0, pos.X - boxW*0.5, 0, pos.Y - boxH*0.5)
                                e.Box.Visible = true
                                e.Stroke.Color = col
                            else e.Box.Visible = false end
                            
                            if State.ESP_Names then
                                e.Name.Text = (isBot and "[BOT] " or "") .. char.Name
                                e.Name.TextColor3 = col
                                e.Name.Position = UDim2.new(0, pos.X - 120, 0, pos.Y - boxH*0.5 - 16)
                                e.Name.Visible = true
                            else e.Name.Visible = false end
                            
                            if State.ESP_Distances then
                                e.Dist.Text = string.format("%dm", math.floor(dist))
                                e.Dist.TextColor3 = col
                                e.Dist.Position = UDim2.new(0, pos.X - 60, 0, pos.Y + boxH*0.5 + 2)
                                e.Dist.Visible = true
                            else e.Dist.Visible = false end
                            
                            if State.ESP_Health then
                                local pct = math.clamp(hum.Health / math.max(hum.MaxHealth, 1), 0, 1)
                                local barX = pos.X - boxW*0.5 - 6
                                e.HpBg.Size = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, boxH + 2)
                                e.HpBg.Position = UDim2.new(0, barX - 1, 0, pos.Y - boxH*0.5 - 1)
                                e.HpBg.Visible = true
                                local hh = boxH * pct
                                e.HpBar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, hh)
                                e.HpBar.Position = UDim2.new(0, barX, 0, pos.Y + boxH*0.5 - hh)
                                e.HpBar.BackgroundColor3 = pct > 0.6 and C.HealthHigh or pct > 0.3 and C.HealthMid or C.HealthLow
                                e.HpBar.Visible = true
                            else
                                e.HpBg.Visible = false; e.HpBar.Visible = false
                            end
                        else
                            e.Box.Visible = false; e.Name.Visible = false; e.Dist.Visible = false
                            e.HpBg.Visible = false; e.HpBar.Visible = false
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    for _, info in ipairs(WorldObjects) do
        local part = info.part
        if part and part.Parent then
            local e = ESP.active[part]
            if not e then e = acquireEntry(); ESP.active[part] = e end
            nowUsed[part] = true
            
            local pos, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
            if onScreen and pos.Z > 0 and pos.X > -80 and pos.X < vp.X + 80 and pos.Y > -80 and pos.Y < vp.Y + 80 then
                local scale = 1000 / math.max(info.dist, 1)
                local sz = math.clamp(2 * scale, 10, 80)
                local col = info.cat == "EXIT" and C.Exit or C.Item
                
                if State.ESP_Boxes then
                    e.Box.Size = UDim2.new(0, sz, 0, sz)
                    e.Box.Position = UDim2.new(0, pos.X - sz*0.5, 0, pos.Y - sz*0.5)
                    e.Box.Visible = true
                    e.Stroke.Color = col
                else e.Box.Visible = false end
                
                if State.ESP_Names then
                    e.Name.Text = part.Name
                    e.Name.TextColor3 = col
                    e.Name.Position = UDim2.new(0, pos.X - 120, 0, pos.Y - sz*0.5 - 16)
                    e.Name.Visible = true
                else e.Name.Visible = false end
                
                if State.ESP_Distances then
                    e.Dist.Text = string.format("%dm", math.floor(info.dist))
                    e.Dist.TextColor3 = col
                    e.Dist.Position = UDim2.new(0, pos.X - 60, 0, pos.Y + sz*0.5 + 2)
                    e.Dist.Visible = true
                else e.Dist.Visible = false end
                
                e.HpBg.Visible = false; e.HpBar.Visible = false
            else
                e.Box.Visible = false; e.Name.Visible = false; e.Dist.Visible = false
                e.HpBg.Visible = false; e.HpBar.Visible = false
            end
        end
    end
    
    for inst, e in pairs(ESP.active) do
        if not nowUsed[inst] or not inst.Parent then
            releaseEntry(e)
            ESP.active[inst] = nil
        end
    end
end)

do
    local bodyVel, bodyGyro
    local function startFly()
        local hrp = getHRP()
        if not hrp then return end
        bodyVel = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
        bodyVel.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
        bodyVel.Velocity = Vector3.zero
        bodyVel.Parent = hrp
        bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
        bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
        bodyGyro.P = 10000
        bodyGyro.CFrame = hrp.CFrame
        bodyGyro.Parent = hrp
    end
    local function stopFly()
        if bodyVel then bodyVel:Destroy(); bodyVel = nil end
        if bodyGyro then bodyGyro:Destroy(); bodyGyro = nil end
    end
    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not State.Fly then
            if bodyVel then stopFly() end
            return
        end
        local hrp = getHRP()
        if not hrp then return end
        if not bodyVel then startFly() return end
        local dir = Vector3.zero
        local cam = camera.CFrame
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then dir += cam.LookVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then dir -= cam.LookVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then dir -= cam.RightVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then dir += cam.RightVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then dir += Vector3.new(0,1,0) end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then dir -= Vector3.new(0,1,0) end
        if dir.Magnitude > 0 then dir = dir.Unit end
        bodyVel.Velocity = dir * State.FlySpeed
        bodyGyro.CFrame = cam
    end)
end

                        g.Enabled = false
                    end

            end

    end
end)

do

end

-- [[ Rscripts Risk Notice ]]
